takes0: A medium-wide shot at eye level, the camera locked off, both fighters seen from head to feet. The fighters are both fighters. Warm daylight from the side lights their faces and clothes, and the hazy air glows behind them. They circle with fists up, then trade fast punches; one blocks, slips the second and drives a hook into the ribs. They crash into a clinch, gripping jackets and shoulders, twisting for position, until one shoves the other away. They break apart and square off again, breathing hard. 40mm lens, deep focus, natural motion blur, steady exposure. The camera does not move at all for the whole shot: no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no tilt. Scuffing shoes on concrete, the slap of blows and heavy breathing.

castRules: An original character: no likeness of any real person, film, comic, game or franchise character, no logo or emblem. The face is fully visible and uncovered: no mask, no balaclava, no helmet visor, no hood over the face. No logos, printed text, brand marks or patches; plain straps; no resemblance to any real person. A distinct silhouette: a clearly different build, hair and outfit shape from other characters. Real fabrics with visible weave, stitching, creases and wear (cotton, leather, wool, denim, nylon), not plastic or latex; natural skin with pores.
